meaning: The request's path, query or body does not match the route's schema. `fieldErrors` names each field.
The request is not allowed for this caller.
The browser origin is not on the API's allow list.
No route at this path, or no transaction build has this id.
The API cannot reach the program on its cluster yet.
A value the route needs is not configured on this deployment.
The build was already submitted with another idempotency key.
The transaction's blockhash expired before it landed. Build again.
The request body is larger than the route accepts.
The request body is not `application/json`.
The transaction failed in simulation.
The cluster refused the transaction.
Too many requests. `retryAfterSeconds` says when to try again.
The API failed.
The RPC or the enclave behind the API did not answer.
No model has this name or address.
The model is not `live`, so it takes no new call.
The model is already sealed, so it takes no write and no second seal.
No enclave has this address or signing key.
The enclave's attestation record has expired.
The enclave's measurement is not in the model's allowed measurements.
No on-chain measurement record exists for this 48-byte digest.
A measurement record for this 48-byte digest is already published on chain.
This measurement record is already marked deprecated.
The measurement digest, recipe hash, source repository, commit SHA, or version is invalid.
The enclave holds no live grant for the model.
No call has this address.
The call already settled or was refunded.
The call's deadline has not passed.
The call's deadline has passed, so it takes no input.
No receipt matches this receipt address, call address or transaction signature.
The envelope sent does not hash to the call's input hash.
The envelope is not a version 1 envelope.
Not every ciphertext byte is written yet.
The hash sent is not the SHA-256 of the bytes written.
The Voynich program refused the transaction. `programError` names the program error.
The wallet holds less than the transaction needs. `funding` gives the mint and the required, available and shortfall amounts.
No bounty has this address.
The bounty is already claimed or cancelled.
